g.text: CreateGameObject(name) (added to m_gameObjects, updated from the next frame)
Awake() (immediately; when loading a scene file, delayed until all values are set)
Update(dt) (through ScriptGuard; a crash only disables this script)
Update(dt): physics results written back to Transform, Animator
